title: AI system record
description: One record per AI system, model or agent. The MLOps gate evaluates it with the Rego policies in mlops/policies against every framework that applies to its countries, sector and entity types.

evaluation_date.description: Date the obligations are evaluated at (defaults to today)

us_localities.description: Localities with their own AI rules (NYC Local Law 144)

provides_public_service.description: Private body providing a public service (EU AI Act Art 27 FRIA duty)

annex_iii_area.description: EU AI Act Annex III use case, or null when none applies

generative.description: Generative AI system (SR 26-2 model-risk guidance excludes these)

placed_on_market_before_2026_08_02.description: Already on the EU market before 2 Aug 2026 (Art 50(2) marking grace to 2 Dec 2026)

tx_prohibited_intent.description: Developed or deployed with an intent Texas TRAIGA prohibits

ot_connected.description: Connected to, hosted with or acting on operational technology / industrial control systems (SCADA, EMS/DMS, plant or pipeline control)

market_facing.description: Generates or executes wholesale bids, offers, nominations or trades (market-sensitive)

policy_approved.description: Operates under an approved AI policy

eu_database_registered.description: Registered in the EU high-risk AI database (Art 49)

gpai_copyright_policy.description: GPAI copyright policy honouring TDM opt-outs

risk_tolerance_defined.description: Risk tolerance for this use case documented (NIST AI RMF MAP 1.5 / GOVERN 1.3)

programme.description: System is in scope of the planned internal audit programme (ISO 19011 cl. 5; ISO/IEC 42001 9.2)

last_audit.description: Date of the last internal audit covering this system (YYYY-MM-DD)

findings_tracked.description: Audit findings tracked to closure (ISO 19011 cl. 6.7)

critical_infrastructure_designation.description: Regulatory designation of the asset the system supports, e.g. SOCI critical electricity asset, OIV (Ley 21.663), CII (Cybersecurity Act), NCCS high-impact entity, 特定社会基盤事業者, BES Cyber System

review_date.description: Scheduled review of the impact assessment (ISO/IEC 42005 cl. 5.12)

interested_parties_identified.description: Affected interested parties and their benefits/harms identified (ISO/IEC 42005 cl. 6.7)

completed.description: Fundamental rights impact assessment completed (AI Act Art 27)

biometric_proportionality_assessment.description: NZ Biometric Processing Privacy Code rule 1 assessment completed

lawful_basis.description: Lawful basis for processing personal data

cross_border_transfer.description: Personal data leaves the home jurisdiction

transfer_mechanism.description: Transfer mechanism (SCCs, adequacy, contract, IPP 12 ground…)

indirect_collection.description: Personal data collected from a source other than the individual (NZ IPP 3A)

no_training_on_customer_data.description: Contract prohibits training on your data

outsourced.description: Function is outsourced to the provider (BS11)

material_service_provider.description: Provider is a material service provider (CPS 230)

register_entry.description: Recorded in the material service provider register

regulator_access_assured.description: Regulator / statutory manager access to systems and data assured (BS11)

ai_bom.description: AI bill of materials maintained: models, tools, MCP servers, datasets (MITRE ATLAS AML.M0023)

managed_identity.description: Uses a managed or federated identity

private_network.description: Reached only over private endpoints / perimeter

short_lived_credentials.description: Agent credentials are per-session and short-lived

non_human_identity_pam.description: Privileged access management covers the non-human identity (APRA AI letter)

egress_allowlist.description: Agent network egress restricted to an allow-list of domains

sandboxed_execution.description: Agent tool/code execution runs in a sandbox with filesystem and network isolation

idp_federated_identity.description: Agent and user identity federated from the corporate IdP (SSO + SCIM), no long-lived vendor keys

ot_zone_conduit_model.description: Placed in a defined IEC 62443-3-3 zone with conduits and a target security level; no direct path from the AI service to control-system zones

content_filters.description: Harmful-content filtering on prompts and outputs

guardrail_enforced_centrally.description: Guardrails enforced outside the application (org policy, gateway, floor setting)

output_validation.description: Model output validated/sanitised before being executed or rendered (OWASP LLM10:2026)

human_in_the_loop.description: Named human approval for consequential or irreversible actions

contest_and_review.description: Affected people can contest the decision and obtain human review (GDPR Art 22; LGPD Art 20; Colorado SB 26-189)

per_action_approval.description: Irreversible agent actions require per-action human approval

ai_disclosure.description: People are told they interact with AI

adm_notice.description: Pre-use notice that an automated decision is made

privacy_policy_adm_disclosure.description: Privacy policy describes automated decisions (AU APP 1.7–1.9)

indirect_collection_notice.description: Individuals notified of indirect collection (NZ IPP 3A)

invocation_logging.description: Prompts, outputs, tool calls and decisions logged

siem_integrated.description: AI telemetry forwarded to the SIEM/SOC (NIST SP 800-61r3 DE.CM)

independent_bias_audit.description: Independent bias audit within the past year (NYC LL144)

completed.description: Threat model covering OWASP LLM Top 10 / Agentic Top 10 and MITRE ATLAS completed

references.description: Threat catalogues used, e.g. OWASP-LLM-2026, OWASP-ASI-2026, MITRE-ATLAS-2026.09

notification_matrix.description: Regulator notification tokens the gate checks: APRA:72h, CSIRT-Nacional; add your own (OAIC:NDB, ANPD, …)

lessons_learned.description: Post-incident lessons-learned process feeds the runbook (NIST SP 800-61r3 ID.IM)

tolerance_levels_set.description: Tolerance levels set for the critical operation (CPS 230)

backup_capability.description: Backup capability for the outsourced function (BS11)

secondary_route.description: A fallback route on another platform or vendor is configured and selectable without rebuild (tools/dr.py)

last_dr_drill.description: Date of the last timed failover drill (YYYY-MM-DD)

approved.description: Model and version on the approved list

drift_and_bias.description: Production monitoring for drift and bias

agent_telemetry.description: Per-action agent telemetry (tool, parameters, outcome) emitted for scope-drift detection (MITRE ATLAS AML.M0024/M0038)

budget_defined.description: A monthly budget exists for this workload (cloud budget and/or broker cap)

token_limits_enforced.description: Token/rate limits enforced at the broker or gateway (LiteLLM budgets, APIM llm-token-limit, provider rate limits)

cost_allocation_tags.description: Tags/dimensions used to allocate cost (workload, team, cost centre)

model_selection_record.description: Path to the selection decision (tools/select_model.py output)

model_selection_date.description: Date of the last model selection run (YYYY-MM-DD)

secondary_route.description: Routing state carries a fallback on another platform/vendor

evidence.description: Evidence as code: one item per piece of evidence that a control is implemented. When this block is present the gate warns on required controls with no evidence and on expired evidence (deny when enforce is true).

enforce.description: Treat expired evidence as a blocking (deny) finding

default_valid_days.description: Validity window applied to items without valid_days

ref.description: URL, ticket id, document id or repository path where the evidence lives

date.description: Date the evidence was produced or last reviewed (YYYY-MM-DD)

valid_days.description: Days the evidence stays valid from `date` (overrides default_valid_days)

sha256.description: Optional content hash of the evidence file at the time of review
